title: Sphere holds 15 ft from a friend's cockpit at Pax River

tellings.quote: fascinating case with one of my good friends who had basically a sphere pull up about 15 feet from his cockpit while he's, you know, maneuvering pretty quickly and hang out there for about 20

plain: A sphere pulled up about 15 feet from a pilot's cockpit near Patuxent River, a Navy air station in Maryland known as Pax River, and stayed there while the pilot was manoeuvring fast. A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves tells Michels this happened to one of his good friends. He offers it as a case where an unknown object kept pace with a military jet at close range.
